name: XRGameBridge
summary: An OpenXR runtime layer specifically for Simulated Reality displays (Acer SpatialLabs, Dimenco SR). Acts as an alternative to SteamVR or native OpenXR runtimes for games using UEVR or native VR — routing the VR output directly to an SR display in SR Weave format. Unlike VRto3D, XRGameBridge preserves LeiaID camera-based headtracking support on compatible SR displays, allowing the displayed view to shift as the user moves their head.
compatibility_notes: SR display required (Acer SpatialLabs, Dimenco). LeiaID headtracking camera required for headtracking features. For non-SR output (SBS, frame sequential), VRto3D remains the correct choice. UEVR must be configured to target XRGameBridge as its OpenXR runtime rather than SteamVR.
